name: Wellness Exams
shortDescription: Comprehensive annual and semi-annual checkups that catch health issues early and keep dogs, cats, and small animals thriving.
description: Preventive care is the foundation of a long, healthy life for your pet. Our wellness exams include a nose-to-tail physical evaluation, weight and body-condition scoring, dental and skin checks, and a tailored wellness plan for every life stage — from playful puppies and kittens to cherished senior companions. Catching problems early means easier, more affordable treatment and more healthy years together.
features: Early detection of common health issues

name: Surgery & Procedures
shortDescription: Safe, modern surgical care — from routine spay/neuter to orthopedic and soft-tissue procedures — with advanced monitoring.
description: Our surgical suite is equipped for everything from routine spay and neuter procedures to complex orthopedic and soft-tissue surgeries. Every patient receives pre-surgical bloodwork, individualized anesthesia protocols, and continuous monitoring of heart rate, oxygen, and blood pressure throughout the procedure. Our team manages pain proactively and stays in close contact with you before, during, and after surgery so your pet recovers comfortably.
seoDescription: Safe veterinary surgery in {{CITY}}, {{STATE}} — spay/neuter, orthopedic, and soft-tissue procedures with advanced anesthesia monitoring.

name: Dental Care
shortDescription: Professional cleanings, digital dental X-rays, and extractions that protect your pet's teeth, gums, and overall health.
description: Dental disease affects the majority of pets by age three and can lead to pain, tooth loss, and damage to the heart, liver, and kidneys. Our dental services include professional cleanings under safe anesthesia, full-mouth digital dental X-rays, polishing, and extractions when needed. We also coach you on at-home dental care so your pet keeps a healthy, pain-free smile between visits.
seoDescription: Veterinary dental care in {{CITY}}, {{STATE}} — professional cleanings, dental X-rays, and extractions to protect your pet's health.

name: Vaccinations & Prevention
shortDescription: Tailored vaccine schedules plus flea, tick, and heartworm prevention to shield your pet from preventable disease.
description: Vaccines and year-round parasite prevention are among the most effective ways to protect your pet. We build a vaccination plan based on your pet's species, age, lifestyle, and risk — never a one-size-fits-all approach. Our prevention program also covers flea, tick, and heartworm protection, along with microchipping so your companion can find their way home if they ever wander.
seoDescription: Pet vaccinations and parasite prevention in {{CITY}}, {{STATE}}. Tailored vaccine schedules plus flea, tick, and heartworm protection.

name: 24/7 Emergency & Urgent Care
shortDescription: Round-the-clock emergency and same-day urgent care when your pet needs help fast — every minute matters.
description: When a pet emergency strikes, you need a team that's ready. Our emergency and urgent care services are available 24/7 for accidents, sudden illness, poisoning, breathing trouble, and other critical situations. We provide rapid triage, stabilization, in-house diagnostics, and hospitalization with around-the-clock monitoring — all delivered with the calm, compassionate communication families need during a frightening time.
seoDescription: 24/7 emergency and urgent veterinary care in {{CITY}}, {{STATE}}. Rapid triage, stabilization, and critical care when your pet needs it most.

name: Internal Medicine & Diagnostics
shortDescription: Advanced in-house diagnostics and chronic-disease management to find answers and create a clear treatment plan.
description: When your pet isn't feeling well, fast and accurate answers matter. Our internal medicine and diagnostic services include in-house bloodwork, digital radiography, ultrasound, and microscopy — so we can diagnose and begin treatment the same day in most cases. We specialize in managing chronic conditions like diabetes, kidney disease, thyroid disorders, and allergies, partnering with you on a long-term care plan that keeps your companion comfortable.
